title: Warmer amber accent (speculative)
description: SPECULATIVE — not recommended over the current palette; default remains to keep the existing amber. Re-defines the attention hue (--color-accent-text / --color-amber-500) as a slightly warmer, deeper amber/orange instead of the current lemon-yellow amber. Still unambiguously amber and still used only for attention states (PRÓXIMO, ABORDANDO/ahora, SALIENDO, the pulsing dot) — no new hue territory, just a warmer shade within amber.

changes.intent: Shift the attention accent toward a warmer, deeper amber for a slightly less lemon/neon feel, while staying within the amber attention-only convention.
changes.detail: Dark theme values shown above (kiosk default). For light theme, the existing --color-accent-text override in :root[data-theme='light'] (#8c6600) should also warm slightly, e.g. #8a5c00 — kept close to current since light-theme accent text is already a dark ink-on-light tone, not a bright chip color. Speculative: default is to keep current amber (#ffd24e / #ffc107).
